parameters.content:
## paper-trading-ranking
Hourly: reads every key (all pages), replays orders, publishes public key `ranking`, remembers seen order keys in Data Table paper_trading_keys, flags users who deleted or overwrote orders. `notify-flag` is disabled until staff notices get a private destination (node `topic`). Ranked traders not yet in group paper-trading are added (members -> any-new? -> add-members, only adds). Paste dist/n8n-ranking.js on top of `rank`.
